## Deviations from Instructions

1. **`GetTypeByMetadataName` instead of `ToDisplayString()` string comparison** — The instructions
   specified detecting types "by string comparison, NO project reference". The implementation uses
   `compilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(metadataName)` combined with `SymbolEqualityComparer` instead
   of comparing `a.AttributeClass?.ToDisplayString()`. This is semantically equivalent (same FQN
   constant used) but more robust. The test stub attribute has the same FQN so both production and
   test cases work identically.

2. **`JsonSerializer.Deserialize<T>(element, options)` instead of `element.Deserialize<T>(options)`**
   — The TASK-DETAIL.md template used `jsonElement.Deserialize<T>(options)` (instance method form).
   The implementation uses the static `global::System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Deserialize<T>(...)`
   overload to avoid a CS1061 resolution error that occurred when the generated file's in-memory
   compilation context did not include a `using System.Text.Json;`. The static form does not require
   any using directive.

3. **Task 5 (runtime integration test) omitted** — Per the batch instructions' own "Simplify Task 5"
   guidance, the fragile runtime integration test class was not created. The generator unit tests
   (Task 4) and the build-time generated file inspection provide equivalent coverage.

## Issues / Debt Items

- **P3**: The generator uses `Collect()` on all syntax nodes with attributes (not pre-filtered by
  the transform), making it less incremental than the ideal pattern. This is functionally correct
  but may cause the generator to re-run more often than necessary on large codebases. A future
  improvement could pass only `TkbDescriptorInfo` (already resolved) into the incremental pipeline.
  Blocked until the incremental caching semantics of `GetTypeByMetadataName`-based lookup are
  clearer.

- **P3**: The generator emits the `RegisterParser` calls in the order the types are encountered in
  syntax traversal (non-deterministic). If order matters for diagnostics or de-registration, an
  explicit sort by hierarchical name could be added.
